import json,numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from PIL import Image

def ee(s,arm):
 p=np.array(s[14+7*arm:21+7*arm]);T=np.eye(4);T[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_quat(p[[4,5,6,3]]).as_matrix();T[:3,3]=p[:3];return T

def cloud(name,cam):
 m=json.load(open('/app/output/'+name+'/meta.json'));d=np.load('/app/output/'+name+'/depth_'+cam+'.npy')[-1].astype(float)/1000
 K=np.array(m['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv']);M=np.array(m['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl'])
 if cam in ['left_camera','right_camera']:
  mi=json.load(open('/app/output/initial/meta.json'));a=int(cam=='right_camera');M=ee(m['proprio']['now'],a)@np.linalg.inv(ee(mi['proprio']['now'],a))@M
 v,u=np.indices(d.shape);p=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d,np.ones_like(d)],-1)@M.T
 return p[:,:,:3]
if __name__=='__main__':
 p=cloud('view_bread','right_camera');im=np.array(Image.open('/app/output/view_bread/last/right_camera.jpg'));mask=(im[:,:,0]>130)&(im[:,:,1]>65)&(im[:,:,2]<140)&(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,2]*1.3);mask[:50]=False;s=p[mask];print('BREAD bounds',np.min(s,0),np.max(s,0),'median',np.median(s,0));print('centerpix',p[148,218])
 for u,v in [(100,150),(150,40),(300,50)]:print('table',u,v,p[v,u])
